name: Voting Condition
definition: Specifies the different voting types, channels and premium.

SecuritiesQuantityRequiredToVote.name: Securities Quantity Required To Vote
SecuritiesQuantityRequiredToVote.definition: Number of holdings required for a vote.

PartialVoteAllowed.name: Partial Vote Allowed
PartialVoteAllowed.definition: Specifies whether it is allowed to only vote on a part of the entire entitled holding, leaving part of the position un-voted.

SplitVoteAllowed.name: Split Vote Allowed
SplitVoteAllowed.definition: Indicates that the option to give a split instruction, for example, a split voting instruction on a meeting, is allowed.

BeneficialOwnerDisclosure.name: Beneficial Owner Disclosure
BeneficialOwnerDisclosure.definition: Indicates whether beneficiary details (eg name and address) must be supplied in order to take part to a meeting.

IncentivePremium.name: Incentive Premium
IncentivePremium.definition: Cash premium made available if the securities holder consents or participates to an event.

VoteInstructionType.name: Vote Instruction Type
VoteInstructionType.definition: Identifies the possible types of voting instructions.

StandingVotingInstruction.name: Standing Voting Instruction
StandingVotingInstruction.definition: Indicates whether standing instructions have been defined or not. In this case, the intermediary should cast the votes according to these instructions.

VotingPremiumAmount.name: Voting Premium Amount
VotingPremiumAmount.definition: Amount of additional weight applied to the votes of long term shareholders.

VotingPremiumRate.name: Voting Premium Rate
VotingPremiumRate.definition: Rate of additional weight applied to the votes of long term shareholders.

PreviousInstructionInvalidity.name: Previous Instruction Invalidity
PreviousInstructionInvalidity.definition: Indicates whether the previously sent instructions becomes invalid after a market deadline extension.

VoteLocation.name: Vote Location
VoteLocation.definition: Electronic address, e-mail or website where a voting ballot can be obtained and/or where a security holder can vote.

Meeting.name: Meeting
Meeting.definition: Meeting for which voting conditions are specified.
